errors.name: Lifetime
errors.msg: Epoch lifetime invalid or previous epoch still active

errors.name: Quote
errors.msg: Quote outside bounded strategy, capacity or lifetime

types.name: AccountQuoteRequest
docs: Schema-3 venue binding is a separate envelope; the reference curve is shared.

fields.name: markets
docs: Canonical index 0 BTC, 1 ETH; immutable after both registrations.

fields.name: mode
docs: 0 custody, 1 isolated trading, 2 cross trading, 3 frozen resolution.

types.name: CurveControlV4
docs: Borsh discriminants 0..3, with no extra vector-length prefix on the payload.

types.name: GroupQuoteRequest
docs: Separate V2 contract binds the group as well as market and isolated capital.

fields.name: positions
docs: Index equals the immutable group's market index, even for empty entries.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Diagnostic cache only; admission recomputes the complete order book.

fields.name: positions
docs: Canonical venue-registry indices, not a user-selected group membership.

fields.name: book
docs: Reuse only the stable scalar wire records; V2 handlers cannot own V3 bytes.

fields.name: status
docs: 0 no credible bounds, 1 degraded, 2 normal (subject to live clock checks).

fields.name: side
docs: Taker side: 0 buys from the maker; 1 sells to it.

fields.name: reference_price
docs: Indicative quote input, never an authenticated risk observation.

fields.name: mode
docs: 0 disabled, 1 enabled, 3 enabled and maker-inventory reduce-only.

fields.name: delegate_epoch
docs: Zero for owner-created authority, otherwise the root's delegate epoch.
